#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class Graph {
private:
    int vNum;
    int src;
    int sink;
    
    vector<vector<int>> res;
    vector<vector<int>> cost;
    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj;
    vector<int> d;
    vector<int> p;
    
    struct Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        int cost;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c) : from(f), to(t), cost(c) {}
    };
    
public:
    int getVertexNumber() {
        return vNum;
    }
    
    Graph(int vNum, int src, int sink) {
        this->vNum = vNum;
        this->src = src;
        this->sink = sink;
        res = vector<vector<int>>(vNum, vector<int>(vNum, 0));
        cost = vector<vector<int>>(vNum, vector<int>(vNum, 0));
        adj = vector<vector<pair<int, int>>>(vNum);
        d = vector<int>(vNum, INT_MAX);
        p = vector<int>(vNum, -1);
    }
    
    void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int costVal) {
        res[from][to] += capacity;
        this->cost[from][to] = costVal;
        this->cost[to][from] = -costVal;
        adj[from].push_back({to, costVal});
        adj[to].push_back({from, -costVal});
    }
    
    bool findCheapestPath() {
        d.assign(vNum, INT_MAX);
        p.assign(vNum, -1);
        
        d[src] = 0;
        
        bool changed = false;
        for(int i = 0; i < vNum - 1; ++i) {
            changed = false;
            for(int u = 0; u < vNum; ++u) {
                if(d[u] == INT_MAX) continue;
                for(auto& edge : adj[u]) {
                    int v = edge.first;
                    int w = edge.second;
                    if(res[u][v] > 0 && d[u] + w < d[v]) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + w;
                        p[v] = u;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(!changed) break;
        }
        
        return p[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    pair<int, int> augmentPath(int from, int to, int flow) {
        int pathCost = 0;
        int minFlow = flow;
        for(int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            minFlow = min(minFlow, res[p[cur]][cur]);
        }
        for(int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            res[p[cur]][cur] -= minFlow;
            res[cur][p[cur]] += minFlow;
            pathCost += cost[p[cur]][cur] * minFlow;
        }
        return {minFlow, pathCost};
    }
    
    vector<int> getMinCostMaxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while(findCheapestPath()) {
            auto result = augmentPath(src, sink, INT_MAX);
            flow += result.first;
            totalCost += result.second;
        }    
        return {flow, totalCost};
    }
};

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
    
public:
    InputReader(istream& inputStream) : in(inputStream) {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        in >> token;
        return token;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int val;
        in >> val;
        return val;
    }
    
    long nextLong() {
        long val;
        in >> val;
        return val;
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        double val;
        in >> val;
        return val;
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        string str;
        getline(in, str);
        return str;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    OutputWriter out(cout);
    
    int letters = 'z' - 'a' + 1;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    string s = in.next();
    vector<char> stringVec(s.begin(), s.end());
    vector<int> letCount(letters, 0);
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        letCount[stringVec[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    vector<int> b(n);
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        b[i] = in.nextInt();
    }
    
    int source = 0;
    int charOffSet = 1;
    int pairOffSet = charOffSet + letters;
    int sinkOffSet = pairOffSet + n / 2;
    int sink = sinkOffSet;
    int vNum = sinkOffSet + 1;
    
    Graph g(vNum, source, sink);
    
    for(int i = 0; i < letters; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(source, charOffSet + i, letCount[i], 0);
        for(int j = 0; j < n/2; ++j) {
            char c1 = stringVec[j];
            char c2 = stringVec[n - j - 1];
            if(c1 == 'a' + i) {
                if(c1 == c2) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]));
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[j]);
                }
            } else {
                if(c2 == 'a' + i) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1]);
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    for(int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(pairOffSet + i, sink, 2, 0);
    }
    
    vector<int> ans = g.getMinCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -ans[1] << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
